content.text: Many digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan face severe restrictions when trying to sell their products online. Platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-which-architecture-actually-works-8|Stripe Alternatives]] and PayPal operate in only 46 out of 195 countries, leaving a huge gap for creators who cannot access these services. This post will explore [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/alternatives-gumroad-payhip-restricted-countries-honest-side-side-9|alternatives]] to Gumroad and Payhip that allow these creators to build a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure without relying on restricted [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-trap-most-creators|COREMERCH guide to payment]] processors.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Gumroad payhip

The landscape of digital commerce is dominated by a few major players, but their reach is limited. For creators in restricted countries, this can mean being unable to sell their work, as conventional platforms often exclude them. The result is a lack of access to global markets and the ability to earn from their creativity. Sovereign commerce infrastructure changes this narrative, allowing these creators to establish their own online stores with autonomy and ownership over their products and data.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this infrastructure is built on freely available tools and decentralized technologies. Platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages can host websites for free, while backend logic can be deployed using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Order storage can be managed through Supabase or even Google Sheets, offering a simple yet powerful solution for tracking sales. Payment processing is facilitated by NOWPayments, which accepts over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing creators with a way to receive payments without the restrictions imposed by traditional payment processors.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are either unavailable or heavily regulated. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, or digital assets, the sovereign commerce infrastructure allows creators to take control of their revenue streams. It empowers them to bypass platforms that exclude them and ensures that they can monetize their work without the fear of account suspensions or access restrictions.
Create your own store with full ownership of your data.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce stack consists of several key components that work in harmony. Hosting can be done on platforms like GitHub Pages, while backend logic is executed through lightweight scripts. Data storage is handled by services like Supabase, and file delivery is managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The integration of NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions is crucial, as it allows for instant payment confirmations and low transaction fees, ensuring that creators receive their payments promptly.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with your own sovereign digital store, first select a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Once you have your product catalog ready, configure your data storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your commerce stack.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, you can sell digital products using a sovereign commerce stack. This architecture allows you to create your own online store using free tools for hosting, backend logic, and payment processing. By utilizing cryptocurrency payments through NOWPayments, you can bypass traditional restrictions and have full control over your sales.
Bypass restrictions that traditional payment platforms impose.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those searching for alternatives to Gumroad or Payhip, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers a powerful solution. This kit includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to establish your own sovereign commerce infrastructure. Explore available resources at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

You can set up a sovereign commerce stack using free hosting, backend logic, and cryptocurrency payment processing. This allows you to create an online store that operates independently of traditional payment platforms.
What is the best alternative to Gumroad for creators in restricted countries?
A sovereign commerce infrastructure is the best alternative, enabling you to build your own store and accept cryptocurrency payments without relying on restricted platforms like Gumroad.
Can I use PayPal if I am in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan?
PayPal services are often limited in these countries, and account suspensions can lead to funds being held for long periods. Alternative solutions are recommended for seamless transactions.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee for processing cryptocurrency transactions, making it a cost-effective option for creators to receive payments.
Is there a way to avoid account suspensions?
By using a sovereign commerce stack, you own your infrastructure and data, eliminating the risks associated with account suspensions from traditional payment platforms.
